visual_review.outcome: All 48 pages rendered and inspected in twelve contact sheets. The final introductory paragraph placement changed pages 1 through 14, which were re-inspected in contact sheets; pages 15 through 48 have unchanged PNG hashes. Pages 1, 2 and 44 through 47 were additionally inspected individually at full rendering size. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or orphaned new heading remains. The arbitrary-maximizer endpoint argument, regularity, endpoint action derivatives, count comparison and explicit equality classification are legible.
